docket.title: Stock launchers: does a printed Payload alone define a canonical ammunition pool?
docket.problem: The statblock prints a Payload and the launcher designation but no launcher count or magazine; the ledger needs a launcher count to run.
docket.canonicalEvidence: Core Rulebook and Starships of the Galaxy statblock Payload lines (recorded as armament.carriedPayloads); SotG pp.45-46 launcher capacities (properties of launchers a ship BUYS).

options.text: The printed Payload is the pool; no magazine / reload modelling for stock groups.
A launcher count must also be established (source-printed or GM-certified); stock groups without one stay GM-configured, never canonical.

docket.consequences: Option 1 makes the ledger run from the Payload alone (no magazine size, no reload step) for stock groups, while installed launchers keep magazines and reload. Option 2 keeps current behaviour and routes these groups to GM configuration.
docket.recommended: Labelled recommendation (not authorisation): none. Option 1 maximises canonical coverage; option 2 preserves the printed-launcher-count standard. The evidence supports both.

docket.title: Weapons whose type has no row in Table 10-2: how is their range resolved?
docket.problem: Table 10-2 (plus the two SotG rows) names 9 weapon types. Stock groups named rocket / grenade / mass-driver / mine / repeating blaster / harpoon etc. match none, so the attack cannot resolve a range band.
docket.canonicalEvidence: Core Rulebook Table 10-2 (Vehicle Weapon Ranges); SotG Table 3-5 additions; data/vehicle-weapon-ranges.json (9 rows).

options.text: Refuse permanently (current): such groups stay non-executable unless a source row is found.
GM-certified range bands per weapon (a new GM-configured outcome, labelled apart from canonical; the record is never edited).
Adopt a stated project convention mapping each such type to an existing Table 10-2 row (owner supplies the mapping).

docket.consequences: Options 2 and 3 can only make the range lookup resolve; each group may still carry other blockers (see unlock estimates).
docket.recommended: Labelled recommendation: source research first - a printed range for some of these weapons may exist in the book entry; decide only for those where the book is silent.

docket.title: Printed attack totals and autofire figures that no published rule reconciles: which is authoritative?
docket.problem: The gate accepts a printed total only when its difference from crew BAB + Int is explained by a published rule (0, +2 pilot, 2(N-1) battery). The groups below differ by other amounts, or print an autofire figure that is not total - 5, or (one case) print two conflicting totals.
docket.canonicalEvidence: Core Rulebook vehicle attack rules (pp.169-171); the statblock printed totals; deltas are recorded per group in the companion JSON.

options.text: Treat the printed total as the published generic crew modifier and record the unexplained delta as source-authoritative (labelled, not reconciled).

docket.consequences: Option 2 accepts the book's number without an explanatory rule; the Eclipse conflict (header +7 vs row +15) would still need a choice of which printed figure governs.
docket.recommended: Labelled recommendation: confirm each printed figure in the PDF first (OCR errors are the likeliest cause of an odd delta); only then decide.

docket.consequences: Option 2 changes the denominator reporting (not the 846): these groups would be neither canonical-executable nor failures, but certified manual.
docket.recommended: Labelled recommendation: option 2 for devices whose book text is purely narrative; option 1 for any the owner wants automated.

forecast.note: Upper bounds under stated conditions. They are NOT promises: a SOURCE_RESEARCH item may end SOURCE_INCOMPLETE; an OWNER_DECISION item may be ruled "refuse"; a GM_CERTIFICATION_OPTION is never canonical.

gmCertificationOnly_notCanonical.label: groups blocked ONLY by the four ammunition facts; a GM configuration (existing route) would run them, labelled GM_CONFIGURED_EXECUTABLE

liveFoundryV13Verification.label: nothing is live-verified; offline functional coverage and production acceptance are separate milestones

residualNeverCanonicalWithoutRuling.label: groups with at least one cause whose source is incomplete/contradictory as recorded
